hypothesis: Whether R3's fixed-reference uncertainty/disagreement score maintains value at operationally frozen review thresholds in previously unused benchmark domains

data.grouping: modechoice train/validation/test split by individual, other datasets stratified rows
data.data_privacy: standard openly packaged survey datasets; no personal identity features or deployment claims

reference_selection: fixed; no validation accuracy or held-out label based model selection
preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted to train only; nonfinite inputs rejected

scores.vote_uncertainty: min(frac audit vote class1, 1-frac audit vote class1)
scores.ensemble_entropy: binary entropy of audit mean p1

streaming_operating_point: threshold and boundary-tie randomization probability derived entirely from validation unlabeled score distribution; one-by-one heldout application; no knowledge of test batch size
batch_diagnostic: label-blind exact top-k on heldout scores; comparison only, not streaming guarantee
inference: descriptive per-dataset/model/split; no independent-split assumption, no familywise hypothesis claim; group-aware bootstrap reserved for modechoice if implemented
negative_results: mandatory; include cases where confidence-only wins and coverage drift undermines comparison
integrity: save fixed protocol digest, input hashes and per-case prediction/score evidence
forbidden: select score coefficient using heldout labels
infer independence of PRNG streams without distributional sampling assumption
